# Introduction

This report analyzes long-term ecosystem dynamics at LTER Site 1 in Moorea, French Polynesia. We examine relationships between benthic community composition, environmental conditions, fish assemblages, and ecosystem metabolism over nearly two decades (2005-2025). The analysis integrates multiple datasets to understand how coral reef ecosystems are responding to environmental change.

# Data

## 1. Temperature Data

Extract yearly average and maximum daily temperature values from the backreef temperature time series.

```{r temperature-processing}
#| label: process-temperature

# Read and process temperature data
Temp_LTER1 <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER02_BTM_Backreef_Forereef_20251114.csv")) |>
  filter(reef_type_code == "Backreef")

# Calculate daily means, then yearly statistics (optimized with single pass)
Mean_year_Temp <- Temp_LTER1 |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(time_local)) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(daily_temp = mean(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Year = year(date)) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    Mean_temp = mean(daily_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_temp = max(daily_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Save processed data
write_csv(Mean_year_Temp, here("Data", "InSituTemp.csv"))

# Quick summary
summary(Mean_year_Temp)
```

## 2. Nutrient Data

Process macroalgae tissue nitrogen content and water column nutrients, using tissue N to impute missing water column data.

```{r nutrient-processing}
#| label: process-nutrients

# Turbinaria %N data (tissue nitrogen as nutrient proxy)
Turb <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER_Macroalgal_CHN_2005_to_2024_20250616.csv")) |>
  filter(
    Habitat == "Backreef",
    Genus == "Turbinaria",
    Site == "LTER_1",
    !is.na(N)
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    N_percent = mean(N, na.rm = TRUE),
    C_percent = mean(C, na.rm = TRUE),
    CN = mean(CN_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(Turb, here("Data", "Turb_mean.csv"))

# Water column nutrients (bimonthly surveys 2005-2018)
# Samples are assigned to austral seasons: summer (Nov-Apr) and winter
# (May-Oct). Sampling actually falls in Dec-Mar (summer) and Jun-Aug
# (winter)
water <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "WaterColumnN.csv")) |>
  filter(Cruise == "LTER bi-annual") |>
  mutate(
    Date = mdy(Date),
    Year = year(Date),
    Season = if_else(month(Date) %in% c(11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4), "Summer", "Winter")
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(across(Phosphate:Nitrite_and_Nitrate,  \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Site = "LTER 1")

write_csv(water, here("Data", "Water_N_mean.csv"))

# Combine tissue and water column nutrient data into a single table
AllNutrients <- Turb |>
  full_join(water, by = "Year") |>
  arrange(Year)

# Water column N+N was only measured through 2018, so we use the tight linear
# relationship between Turbinaria tissue %N (measured 2005–2024) and dissolved
# N+N to interpret the results
modN <- lm(Nitrite_and_Nitrate ~ N_percent, data = AllNutrients)
AllNutrients$NN_impute <- predict(modN, newdata = AllNutrients)

summary(modN)

AllNutrients2 <- AllNutrients |> drop_na()
corTest(x = AllNutrients2$Nitrite_and_Nitrate, y = AllNutrients2$N_percent)
```

## 3. Benthic Cover Data

Calculate percent cover for functional groups from benthic transect surveys.

```{r benthic-processing}
#| label: process-benthic

# Read and classify benthic data
BenthicCover_Algae <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER_Annual_Survey_Benthic_Cover_20251009.csv")) |>
  filter(Habitat == "Backreef")

# Collapse the 50+ taxa in the raw data into broad functional groups based on
# ecological role. The long list of algal species and turf categories all go
# into "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf" because they compete with coral for space
# in similar ways. A handful of uncommon categories (sponges, Tridacna, no
# data entries) are grouped as "Sand" since they occupy space but aren't (<0.5%)
# functionally important to our questions. Everything else keeps its name.
Benthic_summary_Algae <- BenthicCover_Algae |>
  rename(name = Taxonomy_Substrate_Functional_Group) |>
  mutate(
    name = case_when(
      name %in% c(
        "Amansia rhodantha", "Turbinaria ornata", "Dictyota sp.", "Halimeda sp.",
        "Galaxaura sp.", "Liagora ceranoides", "Cyanophyta", "Halimeda minima",
        "Amphiroa fragilissima", "Caulerpa serrulata", "Corallimorpharia",
        "Dictyota friabilis", "Galaxaura rugosa", "Cladophoropsis membranacea",
        "Galaxaura filamentosa", "Halimeda discoidea", "Peyssonnelia inamoena",
        "Caulerpa racemosa", "Valonia ventricosa", "Actinotrichia fragilis",
        "Dictyota bartayresiana", "Microdictyon umbilicatum", "Halimeda distorta",
        "Halimeda incrassata", "Halimeda macroloba", "Dictyota implexa",
        "Gelidiella acerosa", "Dictyosphaeria cavernosa", "Valonia aegagropila",
        "Microdictyon okamurae", "Halimeda opuntia", "Dichotomaria obtusata",
        "Chlorodesmis fastigiata", "Phyllodictyon anastomosans", "Phormidium sp.",
        "Cladophoropsis luxurians", "Sargassum pacificum", "Chnoospora implexa",
        "Halimeda taenicola", "Boodlea kaeneana", "Padina boryana",
        "Coelothrix irregularis", "Gelidiella sp.", "Hydroclathrus clathratus",
        "Dictyota divaricata", "Hypnea spinella", "Dichotomaria marginata",
        "Sporolithon sp.", "Chaetomorpha antennina", "Asparagopsis taxiformis", "Algal Turf", "Damselfish Turf", "Coral Rubble",
        "Lobophora variegata", "Shell Debris", "Bare Space"
      ) ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf",
      name %in% c(
        "Peyssonnelia bornetii", "Peyssonnelia sp.",
        "Sponge", "Tridacna sp.", "No data"
      ) ~ "Sand",
      TRUE ~ name
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Year, Site, name) |>
  summarise(
    total_cover = sum(Percent_Cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cover = 100 * total_cover / 5000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Site = str_replace_all(Site, "_", " "))

write_csv(Benthic_summary_Algae, here("Data", "Benthic_summary_algae.csv"))

# Calculate total calcifiers and living cover
Total_Calc <- Benthic_summary_Algae |>
  filter(name %in% c("Coral", "Crustose Corallines")) |>
  group_by(Year, Site) |>
  reframe(total_Calc = sum(mean_cover))

TotalLiving <- Benthic_summary_Algae |>
  filter(name %in% c("Coral", "Crustose Corallines", "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf")) |>
  group_by(Year, Site) |>
  summarise(
    mean_alive = sum(mean_cover),
    mean_fleshy = sum(mean_cover[name == "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_coral = sum(mean_cover[name == "Coral"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## 4. Fish Biomass Data

Process fish survey data by trophic groups.

```{r fish-processing}
#| label: process-fish

# Read and process fish data
fish <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER_Annual_Fish_Survey_20260304.csv"))

# Process fish into trophic groups. We drop three large sharks (Biomass > 8000 g)
# that show up in the dataset — keeping them would severely bias the "Other"
# category and obscure trends in the ecologically relevant trophic groups.
# Negative Biomass values are a data coding convention for missing observations,
# not real measurements, so those are filtered out too.
fish_summary <- fish |>
  filter(
    Site == "LTER_1",
    Habitat == "Backreef",
    Biomass < 8000, # Remove outlier sharks
    Biomass >= 0 # Remove negative (missing) values
  ) |>
  mutate(
    trophic_new = case_when(
      Fine_Trophic %in% c("Brusher", "Browser", "Excavator","Concealed Cropper","Cropper",                                    "Scraper","Herbivore/Detritivore") ~ "Herbivores",
      Fine_Trophic == "Corallivore" ~ "Corallivore",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Year, trophic_new) |>
  summarise(
    fish_g_m2 = sum(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE) / 1200, # 4 transects × 300 m²
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(fish_summary, here("Data", "fish_summary.csv"))

# Read in Fish respiration data (calculated from fish_respiration.R)
fish_respiration<- read_csv(here("Data", "fish_respiration.csv")) |>
  filter(Site == "LTER_1")|>
  select(Year, fish_biomass_g_m2, Rfish_field_mmolO2_m2_h, Rfish_field_se) 
```

## 5. Primary Production Processing

Process raw production data and extract Pmax and Rd using Bayesian photosynthesis-irradiance curves.

```{r pp-processing}
#| label: process-pp
#| cache: true

# Read all QC PP files efficiently
filedir <- here("Data", "raw_data", "QC_PP")
files <- dir(path = filedir, pattern = ".csv", full.names = TRUE)

All_PP_data <- files |>
  set_names() |>
  map_df(read_csv, .id = "filename", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(DateTime = mdy_hm(DateTime))

# The instrument setup changed in April 2014, shifting the output units from
# mg O2/m2/h to umol O2/m2/h. Convert the earlier records to match, then
# build date variables and drop a handful of deployment days with known QC
# issues (equipment failures, storm interference).
All_PP_data <- All_PP_data |>
  mutate(
    # Convert 2007–2014 records from g O2/m2/h to mmol O2/m2/h
    across(
      c(UP_Oxy, DN_Oxy, PP),
      ~ if_else(DateTime < ymd_hms("2014-04-01 00:00:00"), (.x / 32) * 1000, .x)
    ),
    Date = as_date(DateTime),
    DielDateTime = DateTime + hours(12),
    DielDate = as_date(DielDateTime),
    Year = year(DateTime)
  ) |>
  filter(!Date %in% mdy(c("5/27/2011", "5/28/2011", "1/21/2014", "05/25/2024")))

# Keep only days with all 24 hourly measurements — partial days would
# bias the daily metabolic integrals (e.g., missing nighttime R hours

complete_dates <- All_PP_data |>
  count(DielDate) |>
  filter(n == 24)

All_PP_data <- complete_dates |>
  left_join(All_PP_data, by = "DielDate")

# Calculate GP and environmental averages
Daily_R <- All_PP_data |>
  group_by(Year, Season, DielDate) |>
  summarise(R_average = mean(PP[PAR == 0], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

All_PP_data <- All_PP_data |>
  left_join(Daily_R, by = c("Year", "Season", "DielDate")) |>
  mutate(
    GP = if_else(PAR == 0, NA_real_, PP - R_average),
    GP = if_else(GP < 0, NA_real_, GP),
    Temperature_mean = (UP_Temp + DN_Temp) / 2,
    Flow_mean = (UP_Velocity_mps + DN_Velocity_mps) / 2
  )

# Calculate yearly averages by year and austral season, matching the
# YearSeason resolution of the Bayesian PI-curve model
Year_Averages_PP <- All_PP_data |>
  mutate(
    NP = PP,
    R = if_else(PP < 0, PP, NA_real_)
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    NP_mean = mean(NP, na.rm = TRUE),
    NP_SE = sd(NP, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    NP_max = max(NP, na.rm = TRUE),
    GP_mean = mean(GP, na.rm = TRUE),
    GP_SE = sd(GP, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    R_mean = mean(R, na.rm = TRUE),
    R_SE = sd(R, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Temperature_mean = mean(Temperature_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Flow_mean = mean(Flow_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    PAR_mean = mean(PAR[PAR > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Also do it by Season
YearSeason_Averages_PP <- All_PP_data |>
  mutate(
    NP = PP,
    R = if_else(PP < 0, PP, NA_real_)
  ) |>
  group_by(Year, Season) |>
  summarise(
    NP_mean = mean(NP, na.rm = TRUE),
    NP_SE = sd(NP, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    NP_max = max(NP, na.rm = TRUE),
    GP_mean = mean(GP, na.rm = TRUE),
    GP_SE = sd(GP, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    R_mean = mean(R, na.rm = TRUE),
    R_SE = sd(R, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Temperature_mean = mean(Temperature_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Flow_mean = mean(Flow_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    PAR_mean = mean(PAR[PAR > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Bayesian Photosynthesis-Irradiance (PI) Curve Analysis

We fit a Bayesian non-linear model to extract photosynthetic parameters (alpha, Pmax, and Rd) for each year. The model uses a rectangular hyperbola:

$$PP = \frac{\alpha \cdot P_{max} \cdot PAR}{\alpha \cdot PAR + P_{max}} + R_d$$

where: - $\alpha$ = initial slope (photosynthetic efficiency) - $P_{max}$ = maximum photosynthetic capacity - $R_d$ = dark respiration (ecosystem respiration) - $PAR$ = photosynthetically active radiation

```{r bayesian-pi-curve}
#| label: bayesian-pi-curve
#| cache: true
#| dependson: ["process-pp"]

# Bayesian PI curves to extract light-independent Pmax and Rd
LTER1_Pnet <- All_PP_data |>
  mutate(
    tempc = Temperature_mean,
    Flowmean = Flow_mean,
    flow_log = log(Flowmean),
    UPDN = as.factor(UPDN),
    Year = as.factor(Year),
    Season = as.factor(Season),
    YearSeason = as.factor(paste(Year,Season))
  )

# Fit the PI curve as a Bayesian non-linear model rather than ordinary least
# squares because we need full uncertainty estimates on Pmax and Rd for each
# year — those uncertainties propagate through the SEM later. The Student-t
# likelihood handles the occasional outlier measurement without letting it
# distort the curve. All three parameters (alpha, Pmax, Rd) are estimated
# simultaneously across all years, with year-specific coefficients for each.
# This will take a while — run with cache: true.
fit1_f <- brm(
  bf(
    PP ~ ((alpha * Pmax * PAR) / (alpha * PAR + Pmax)) + Rd,
    nl = TRUE,
    alpha ~ 0 + Year,
    Pmax ~ 0 + Year,
    Rd ~ 0 + Year
  ) + student(),
  data = LTER1_Pnet,
  set_rescor(FALSE),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0.1, 10), nlpar = "alpha", lb = 0),
    prior(normal(-100, 10), nlpar = "Rd", ub = 0),
    prior(normal(100, 10), nlpar = "Pmax", lb = 0)
  ),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 20),
  cores = 3,
  chains = 3,
  seed = 223,
  iter = 8000,
  warmup = 2000
)

# Extract Pmax and Rd coefficients
names <- rownames(fixef(fit1_f))
coefficients <- as_tibble(fixef(fit1_f)) |>
  mutate(params = names)

PRValues <- coefficients |>
  separate(params, sep = "_", into = c("param_type", "yearname"), remove = FALSE) |>
  filter(param_type %in% c("Pmax", "Rd")) |>
  separate(yearname, sep = "r", into = c("y", "year")) |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) |>
  select(Year = year, Estimate, param_type) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = param_type, values_from = Estimate)

# Combine with raw averages
Year_Averages_PP <- Year_Averages_PP |>
  full_join(PRValues, by = "Year") |>
  mutate(Rd = -Rd) # Make Rd positive

# Calculate Bayesian R²
pi_curve_r2 <- median(bayes_R2(fit1_f)[, 1])
cat(sprintf("\nPhotosynthesis-Irradiance Curve Model:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Bayesian R²: %.3f\n", pi_curve_r2))
cat(sprintf("  This indicates the model explains %.1f%% of variance in net production\n", pi_curve_r2 * 100))

write_csv(Year_Averages_PP, here("Data", "Year_Averages_PP.csv"))
```

## FIT PI-curve by season as well

```{r bayesian-pi-curve-season}
#| label: bayesian-pi-curve-season
#| cache: true
#| dependson: ["process-pp"]

# Fit the PI curve as a Bayesian non-linear model rather than ordinary least
# squares because we need full uncertainty estimates on Pmax and Rd for each
# year — those uncertainties propagate through the SEM later. The Student-t
# likelihood handles the occasional outlier measurement without letting it
# distort the curve. All three parameters (alpha, Pmax, Rd) are estimated
# simultaneously across all years, with year-specific coefficients for each.
# This will take a while — run with cache: true.
fit1_f <- brm(
  bf(
    PP ~ ((alpha * Pmax * PAR) / (alpha * PAR + Pmax)) + Rd,
    nl = TRUE,
    alpha ~ 0 + YearSeason,
    Pmax ~ 0 + YearSeason,
    Rd ~ 0 + YearSeason
  ) + student(),
  data = LTER1_Pnet,
  set_rescor(FALSE),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0.1, 10), nlpar = "alpha", lb = 0),
    prior(normal(-100, 10), nlpar = "Rd", ub = 0),
    prior(normal(100, 10), nlpar = "Pmax", lb = 0)
  ),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 20),
  cores = 3,
  chains = 3,
  seed = 223,
  iter = 8000,
  warmup = 2000
)

# Extract Pmax and Rd coefficients
names <- rownames(fixef(fit1_f))
coefficients <- as_tibble(fixef(fit1_f)) |>
  mutate(params = names)

PRValues_season <- coefficients |>
  # params look like "Pmax_YearSeason2008Summer" (brms strips the space in
  # "2008 Summer"); extract year and season with regex
  filter(str_detect(params, "^(Pmax|Rd)_")) |>
  mutate(
    param_type = str_extract(params, "^(Pmax|Rd)"),
    year = as.numeric(str_extract(params, "[0-9]{4}")),
    Season = str_extract(params, "(Summer|Winter)")
  ) |>
  select(Year = year, Season, Estimate, param_type) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = param_type, values_from = Estimate)

# Combine with raw averages
YearSeason_Averages_PP <- YearSeason_Averages_PP |>
  full_join(PRValues_season, by = c("Year", "Season")) |>
  mutate(Rd = -Rd) # Make Rd positive

# Calculate Bayesian R²
pi_curve_r2 <- median(bayes_R2(fit1_f)[, 1])
cat(sprintf("\nPhotosynthesis-Irradiance Curve Model:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Bayesian R²: %.3f\n", pi_curve_r2))
cat(sprintf("  This indicates the model explains %.1f%% of variance in net production\n", pi_curve_r2 * 100))

write_csv(YearSeason_Averages_PP, here("Data", "YearSeason_Averages_PP.csv"))
```

## 6. Integrate All Datasets

```{r integrate-data}
#| label: integrate-datasets

# Read processed data files
Year_Averages_PP <- read_csv(here("Data", "Year_Averages_PP.csv"))
YearSeason_Averages_PP <- read_csv(here("Data", "YearSeason_Averages_PP.csv"))
Turb <- read_csv(here("Data", "Turb_mean.csv"))
water <- read_csv(here("Data", "Water_N_mean.csv"))
insitu_temp <- read_csv(here("Data", "InSituTemp.csv"))

fish_trophic <- read_csv(here("Data", "fish_summary.csv")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = trophic_new, values_from = fish_g_m2) |>
#  mutate(fish_total = rowSums(across(Corallivore:Other))) |>
  select(-Other) |>
  full_join(fish_respiration)

Benthic_summary_Algae <- read_csv(here("Data", "Benthic_summary_algae.csv"))

# Create integrated dataset
Year_Averages <- Year_Averages_PP |>
  select(-c(NP_max:R_SE))|>
  full_join(TotalLiving |> filter(Site == "LTER 1"), by = "Year") |>
  full_join(water) |>
  full_join(Turb, by = "Year") |>
  full_join(insitu_temp, by = "Year") |>
  full_join(fish_trophic, by = "Year") |>
  mutate(log_coral = log(mean_coral)) |>
  mutate(coral_dominance = log(mean_coral/mean_fleshy))|>
  filter(Year < 2026) |>
  mutate(benthic_R = Rd - Rfish_field_mmolO2_m2_h) |> # total R - fish R
  arrange(Year)

# Display structure
glimpse(Year_Averages)

# Do it by year and season too
# Create integrated dataset
YearSeason_Averages <- YearSeason_Averages_PP |>
  select(-c(NP_max:R_SE))|>
  full_join(TotalLiving |> filter(Site == "LTER 1"), by = "Year") |>
  full_join(water) |>
  full_join(Turb, by = "Year") |>
  full_join(insitu_temp, by = "Year") |>
  full_join(fish_trophic, by = "Year") |>
  mutate(log_coral = log(mean_coral)) |>
  mutate(coral_dominance = log(mean_coral/mean_fleshy))|>
  filter(Year < 2026) |>
  mutate(benthic_R = Rd - Rfish_field_mmolO2_m2_h) |> # total R - fish R
  arrange(Year, Season)
```

## Temporal Trends

Assess standardized change per year using Bayesian linear models.

```{r temporal-trends}
#| label: temporal-trends
#| cache: true
#| dependson: ["integrate-datasets", "bayesian-pi-curve", "process-pp", "process-benthic", "process-nutrients", "process-temperature", "process-fish"]

# Create standardized dataset
std_data <- Year_Averages |>
  select(
    mean_coral, mean_fleshy, Pmax, Rd, N_percent,
    Herbivores, Corallivore,fish_biomass_g_m2, NP_mean, Max_temp, 
    Nitrite_and_Nitrate, Phosphate
  ) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) |>
  bind_cols(Year_Averages |> select(Year))

# Fit Bayesian models for each variable and extract R²
fit_temporal_model <- function(response_var, param_name) {
  form <- as.formula(paste(response_var, "~ Year"))
  mod <- brm(form, data = std_data, silent = 2, refresh = 0, seed = 223)
  
  # Extract posterior samples
  post <- as_tibble(as.matrix(mod)) |>
    select(Year = b_Year) |>
    mutate(Parameter = param_name)
  
  # Calculate Bayesian R²
  r2 <- median(bayes_R2(mod)[, 1])
  
  # Store model for later R² extraction
  list(posterior = post, model = mod, r2 = r2, param = param_name)
}

# Fit all models
temporal_models <- list(
  fit_temporal_model("mean_coral", "% Coral Cover"),
  fit_temporal_model("mean_fleshy", "% Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf Cover"),
  fit_temporal_model("Corallivore", "Corallivore"),
  fit_temporal_model("Herbivores", "Herbivore/Bioeroding Fish"),
  fit_temporal_model("fish_biomass_g_m2", "Total Fish Biomass"),
  fit_temporal_model("N_percent", "%N Content"),
  fit_temporal_model("Rd", "Ecosystem Respiration"),
  fit_temporal_model("Pmax", "Maximum Photosynthetic Capacity"),
  fit_temporal_model("NP_mean", "Net Ecosystem Production"),
  fit_temporal_model("Max_temp", "Max Temperature"),
  fit_temporal_model("Nitrite_and_Nitrate", "Nitrate + Nitrite")
)

# Extract posteriors for plotting
temporal_results <- temporal_models |>
  map_df(~.x$posterior)

# Print R² values
cat("\n=== Temporal Trend Model Performance (Bayesian R²) ===\n\n")
temporal_models |>
  map_df(~tibble(Parameter = .x$param, R2 = .x$r2)) |>
  arrange(desc(R2)) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r temporal-plot}
#| label: fig-temporal
#| cache: false
#| fig-cap: "**Figure 2.** Bayesian temporal trends for each variable."
#| fig-width: 8.2
#| fig-height: 11.81

# Noto Sans has full Unicode coverage (superscripts, µ, °, subscripts)
font_add_google("Noto Sans", family = "noto")
showtext_auto()

theme_nature <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text             = element_text(family = "noto"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = base_size, color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.line        = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, color = "black"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(size = 10, face = "plain", color = "grey20"),
      panel.spacing    = unit(0.5, "lines"),
      legend.position  = "none",
      plot.tag         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
    )
}

col_inc <- "#E64B35"   # NPG red  — increasing
col_dec <- "#4DBBD5"   # NPG teal — decreasing

# ── Summarise posterior slopes (order + color mapping) ─────────────────────
slope_summary <- temporal_results |>
  group_by(Parameter) |>
  summarise(
    median_slope = median(Year),
    direction    = if_else(median_slope > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(median_slope)

param_levels <- slope_summary$Parameter

# ── Scale parameters — defined here so they are available to both panels ────
short_label_map <- tibble(
  var = c("mean_coral", "mean_fleshy", "Corallivore", "Herbivores",
          "N_percent", "Rd", "Pmax", "NP_mean", "Max_temp", "Nitrite_and_Nitrate", "fish_biomass_g_m2"),
  Parameter = c("% Coral Cover", "% Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf Cover", "Corallivore",
                "Herbivore/Bioeroding Fish", "%N Content", "Ecosystem Respiration",
                "Maximum Photosynthetic Capacity", "Net Ecosystem Production",
                "Max Temperature", "Nitrate + Nitrite", "Total Fish Biomass"),
  label = c(
    "Coral cover\n(%)",
    "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf\n(%)",
    "Corallivore\n(g m\u207b\u00b2)",
    "Herbivores\n(g m\u207b\u00b2)",
    "N content\n(%)",
    "Respiration\n(mmol O\u2082 m\u207b\u00b2 hr\u207b\u00b9)",
    "Pmax\n(mmol O\u2082 m\u207b\u00b2 hr\u207b\u00b9)",
    "NEP\n(mmol O\u2082 m\u207b\u00b2 hr\u207b\u00b9)",
    "Max temperature\n(\u00b0C)",
    "Nitrate+nitrite\n(\u00b5mol L\u207b\u00b9)",
    "All Fish\n(g m\u207b\u00b2)"
  )
)

scale_params <- tibble(
  var = short_label_map$var,
  mu  = map_dbl(short_label_map$var, \(x) mean(Year_Averages[[x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
  sd  = map_dbl(short_label_map$var, \(x) sd(Year_Averages[[x]],   na.rm = TRUE))
) |>
  left_join(short_label_map, by = "var")

label_levels <- scale_params$label[match(param_levels, scale_params$Parameter)]

# Short names for panel a y-axis (strip units line from panel b labels)
short_name_map <- scale_params |>
  select(Parameter, label) |>
  mutate(short_name = str_remove(label, "\n.*"))

# ── Panel a: Posterior density ridges ──────────────────────────────────────
panel_a <- temporal_results |>
  left_join(slope_summary |> select(Parameter, direction), by = "Parameter") |>
  left_join(short_name_map, by = "Parameter") |>
  mutate(short_name = factor(short_name, levels = short_name_map$short_name[match(param_levels, short_name_map$Parameter)])) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = short_name, fill = direction)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.35, color = "grey55"
  ) +
  stat_density_ridges(
    quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = c(0.025, 0.975),
    alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.25, color = "white",
    scale = 0.88, rel_min_height = 0.01
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increasing" = col_inc, "Decreasing" = col_dec)) +
  # Directional indicators via geom_segment — no Unicode font dependency
  annotate("segment",
           x = 0.02, xend = 0.26, y = 0.38, yend = 0.38,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), ends = "last", type = "closed"),
           color = col_inc, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.035, y = 0.38, label = "Increasing",
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5,
           color = col_inc, fontface = "italic", family = "noto") +
  annotate("segment",
           x = -0.02, xend = -0.26, y = 0.38, yend = 0.38,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), ends = "last", type = "closed"),
           color = col_dec, linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.035, y = 0.38, label = "Decreasing",
           hjust = 1, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5,
           color = col_dec, fontface = "italic", family = "noto") +
  labs(x = "Standardized change per year", y = NULL, tag = "A") +
  lims(x = c(-0.35, 0.35)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_nature() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),
    # Left margin wide enough for the longest ridge y-axis label
    plot.margin  = margin(5, 5, 5, 45, unit = "pt")
  )

# Pull fitted values and raw data from each Bayesian trend model and
# back-transform from z-scores to original measurement units for plotting.
get_time_series <- function(model_obj) {
  mod      <- model_obj$model
  param    <- model_obj$param
  resp_var <- as.character(formula(mod)$formula)[2]
  # Limit fitted predictions to the years actually observed for this
  # parameter (some series have missing tail years, e.g. N+N ends 2018),
  # so prediction lines don't extrapolate past the data
  year_seq <- tibble(Year = seq(min(std_data$Year[!is.na(std_data[[resp_var]])]),
                                max(std_data$Year[!is.na(std_data[[resp_var]])]),
                                by = 0.5))
  fitted_df <- fitted(mod, newdata = year_seq) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    bind_cols(year_seq) |>
    mutate(Parameter = param)
  raw_df <- std_data |>
    select(Year, value = all_of(resp_var)) |>
    mutate(Parameter = param)
  list(fitted = fitted_df, raw = raw_df)
}

all_series <- map(temporal_models, get_time_series)

fitted_all <- map_df(all_series, ~.x$fitted) |>
  left_join(slope_summary |> select(Parameter, direction), by = "Parameter") |>
  left_join(scale_params |> select(Parameter, mu, sd, label), by = "Parameter") |>
  mutate(
    Estimate_orig = Estimate * sd + mu,
    Q2.5_orig     = Q2.5    * sd + mu,
    Q97.5_orig    = Q97.5   * sd + mu,
    label = factor(label, levels = label_levels)
  )

raw_all <- map_df(all_series, ~.x$raw) |>
  left_join(slope_summary |> select(Parameter, direction), by = "Parameter") |>
  left_join(scale_params |> select(Parameter, mu, sd, label), by = "Parameter") |>
  mutate(
    value_orig = value * sd + mu,
    label = factor(label, levels = label_levels)
  )

# ── Bayesian R² annotations ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
r2_df <- map_df(temporal_models, ~tibble(Parameter = .x$param, r2 = .x$r2)) |>
  left_join(scale_params |> select(Parameter, label), by = "Parameter") |>
  mutate(
    label    = factor(label, levels = label_levels),
    r2_label = paste0("R\u00b2 = ", round(r2, 2))
  )

# ── Y-axis labels via expression(atop()) — reliable across all PDF fonts ─────
# ── Y-axis labels: single-line expressions ───────────────────────────────────
# Single-line keeps the rotated title height ≈ font size (~10 pt) vs two-line
# atop() which doubles it, causing excess gap between label and plot area.
yaxis_labels <- list(
  "% Coral Cover"                   = "Coral cover (%)",
  "% Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf Cover" = "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf (%)",
  "Corallivore"                     = expression("Corallivore (g m"^-2*")"),
  "Herbivore/Bioeroding Fish"       = expression("Herbivores (g m"^-2*")"),
  "%N Content"                      = "N content (%)",
  "Ecosystem Respiration"           = expression("Rd (mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" h"^-1*")"),
  "Maximum Photosynthetic Capacity" = expression("Pmax (mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" h"^-1*")"),
  "Net Ecosystem Production"        = expression("NEP (mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" h"^-1*")"),
  "Max Temperature"                 = "Max temp. (\u00b0C)",
  "Nitrate + Nitrite"               = expression("N+N (\u00b5mol L"^-1*")"),
  "Total Fish Biomass"              = expression("All Fish (g m"^-2*")")
)

# ── Individual panels B–K ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# show_xticks: TRUE only for bottom row (J, K = positions 9–10)
make_ts_panel <- function(param_name, letter, show_xticks = FALSE) {
  fd <- fitted_all |> filter(Parameter == param_name)
  rd <- raw_all    |> filter(Parameter == param_name)
  r2 <- r2_df      |> filter(Parameter == param_name)

  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = fd,
      aes(x = Year, ymin = Q2.5_orig, ymax = Q97.5_orig, fill = direction),
      alpha = 0.18) +
    geom_line(data = fd,
      aes(x = Year, y = Estimate_orig, color = direction),
      linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_point(data = rd, aes(x = Year, y = value_orig),
      size = 0.85, alpha = 0.70, shape = 16, color = "grey25") +
    geom_text(data = r2, aes(label = r2_label),
      x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.4,
      size = 3.5, color = "grey45", fontface = "italic", family = "noto") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Increasing" = col_inc, "Decreasing" = col_dec)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Increasing" = col_inc, "Decreasing" = col_dec)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2008, 2014, 2020)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = yaxis_labels[[param_name]], tag = letter) +
    theme_nature() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = if (show_xticks)
                      element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10)
                    else
                      element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x        = if (show_xticks) element_line() else element_blank(),
      axis.text.y         = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 1, unit = "pt")),
      axis.title.y        = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1, unit = "pt")),
      axis.ticks.length.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      plot.tag.position   = c(0.04, 0.96),
      plot.tag            = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0, vjust = 1),
      plot.margin         = margin(5, 5, 5, 2, unit = "pt")
    )
}

ts_panels_all <- pmap(
  list(param_levels, LETTERS[2:12], seq_along(param_levels) > 8),
  \(p, l, show) make_ts_panel(p, l, show_xticks = show)
)

# Equalize panel sizes by aligning left and right columns separately.
# align_plots(align = "v", axis = "l") pads the narrower y-axis areas within
# each column to match the widest, so all panels in a column have equal data-area
# widths. Columns are aligned independently to avoid over-padding.
left_aligned  <- cowplot::align_plots(
  plotlist = ts_panels_all[c(1, 3, 5, 7, 9)],  # B D F H J
  align = "v", axis = "l"
)
right_aligned <- cowplot::align_plots(
  plotlist = ts_panels_all[c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)],  # C E G I K
  align = "v", axis = "l"
)

all_aligned <- vector("list", 10)
all_aligned[c(1, 3, 5, 7, 9)]  <- left_aligned
all_aligned[c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)] <- right_aligned

panel_b <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = all_aligned, ncol = 2, align = "none")

# ── Combine and render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Heights ratio 1:3.3 ≈ Panel A (~70 mm ridge) : Panel B (5 rows × ~46 mm)
fig7 <- panel_a / wrap_elements(panel_b) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 3.3)) &
  theme(plot.background = element_blank())

fig7

ggsave(
  here("Output", "fig2_temporal_trends.pdf"),
  plot   = fig7,
  width  = 183,
```
