### Temporal Rates of Change (Natural Scale)

```{r temporal-rate-table}
#| label: tbl-temporal-rates
#| cache: false
#| tbl-cap: "**Annual rates of change on the natural scale for each measured ecosystem parameter at MCR LTER Site 1 backreef, 2005–2025.**"

# Units lookup (natural-scale units per year for each variable)
units_map_doc <- tibble(
  var   = c("mean_coral", "mean_fleshy", "Corallivore", "Herbivores","fish_biomass_g_m2",
            "N_percent", "Rd", "Pmax", "NP_mean", "Max_temp", "Nitrite_and_Nitrate"),
  Units = c("% cover yr\u207b\u00b9", "% cover yr\u207b\u00b9",
            "g m\u207b\u00b2 yr\u207b\u00b9", "g m\u207b\u00b2 yr\u207b\u00b9","g m\u207b\u00b2 yr\u207b\u00b9",
            "% N yr\u207b\u00b9",
            "mmol O\u2082 m\u207b\u00b2 hr\u207b\u00b9 yr\u207b\u00b9",
            "mmol O\u2082 m\u207b\u00b2 hr\u207b\u00b9 yr\u207b\u00b9",
            "mmol O\u2082 m\u207b\u00b2 hr\u207b\u00b9 yr\u207b\u00b9",
            "\u00b0C yr\u207b\u00b9", "\u00b5mol L\u207b\u00b9 yr\u207b\u00b9")
)

# Summarise posterior slopes from temporal_results into median + 95% CI
slope_tbl_doc <- temporal_results |>
  group_by(Parameter) |>
  summarise(
    median_std = median(Year),
    lo95_std   = quantile(Year, 0.025),
    hi95_std   = quantile(Year, 0.975),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

slope_tbl_doc |>
  left_join(scale_params |> select(Parameter, sd, var), by = "Parameter") |>
  left_join(units_map_doc, by = "var") |>
  mutate(
    natural_slope = median_std * sd,
    natural_lo95  = lo95_std  * sd,
    natural_hi95  = hi95_std  * sd,
    credible      = sign(lo95_std) == sign(hi95_std),
    Rate = sprintf("%.3g (%s, %s)%s",
                   natural_slope,
                   formatC(natural_lo95, digits = 2, format = "g"),
                   formatC(natural_hi95, digits = 2, format = "g"),
                   if_else(credible, "\u2020", "")),
    Direction = if_else(median_std > 0, "\u2191 Increasing", "\u2193 Decreasing")
  ) |>
  arrange(median_std) |>
  select(Parameter, Units, `Rate (95% CI)` = Rate, Direction) |>
  kbl(align = c("l", "l", "r", "c")) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    position          = "left"
  ) |>
  footnote(
    general       = "\u2020 95% credible interval excludes zero.",
    general_title = ""
  )
```
### Add lagged data for SEMs

```{r lagged-covariates}
#| label: lagged-covariates

# Add 1-year-lagged covariates for use in the SEMs. lag() operates on row
# order, so Year is arranged first to guarantee correct alignment.
Year_Averages <- Year_Averages |>
  arrange(Year) |>
  mutate(
    Herbivores_lag1  = lag(Herbivores),
    Corallivore_lag1 = lag(Corallivore),
    Max_temp_lag1    = lag(Max_temp)
  )

# Season dataset: lag() on row order would pull the same year's Summer value
# into Winter rows, so join the annual lags by Year instead.
YearSeason_Averages <- YearSeason_Averages |>
  select(-any_of(c("Herbivores_lag1", "Corallivore_lag1", "Max_temp_lag1"))) |>
  left_join(
    Year_Averages |> select(Year, Herbivores_lag1, Corallivore_lag1, Max_temp_lag1),
    by = "Year"
  ) |>
  arrange(Year, Season)

# Major disturbance years in Moorea (1 = disturbance, 0 = none).
# Sources:
#   COTS outbreak 2006-2010: Kayal et al. 2012, PLoS ONE 7:e47363,
#     doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0047363; Adam et al. 2011, PLoS ONE 6:e23717,
#     doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0023717
#   Cyclone Oli, Feb 2010: Adam et al. 2011 (above)
#   2016 bleaching: Hedouin et al. 2020, Coral Reefs,
#     doi:10.1007/s00338-020-01914-w; lagoon bleaching in Donovan et al. 2020,
#     PNAS, doi:10.1073/pnas.1915395117
#   2019 marine heatwave/bleaching: Speare et al. 2021, Global Change
#     Biology, doi:10.1111/gcb.16000
# Caveat: COTS and Cyclone Oli impacts were concentrated on the fore reef;
# effects on the LTER_1 back reef were smaller, so coding these years as
# disturbances for the back reef is a judgement call.
disturbance_years <- tribble(
  ~Year, ~Disturbance_notes,
  2006, "COTS outbreak (onset)",
  2007, "COTS outbreak",
  2008, "COTS outbreak",
  2009, "COTS outbreak (peak)",
  2010, "COTS outbreak (end) + Cyclone Oli (Feb 2010)",
  2016, "Bleaching (3rd global bleaching event)",
  2019, "Bleaching (marine heatwave)",
  2024, "Bleaching (marine heatwave)"
)

add_disturbance <- function(d) {
  d |>
    # Drop existing columns so re-running the chunk interactively is safe
    select(-any_of(c("Disturbance", "Disturbance_notes"))) |>
    left_join(disturbance_years, by = "Year") |>
    mutate(
      Disturbance = if_else(is.na(Disturbance_notes), 0L, 1L),
      Disturbance_notes = replace_na(Disturbance_notes, "None")
    )
}

Year_Averages       <- add_disturbance(Year_Averages)
YearSeason_Averages <- add_disturbance(YearSeason_Averages)

Year_Averages |> select(Year, Disturbance, Disturbance_notes)
```
## Seasonal Structural Equation modeling
Fit a Bayesian SEM to understand causal pathways among ecosystem components.
| # | Equation |
|---|----------|
| 1 | Temperature ~ Year |
| 2 | Benthic composition (coral, fleshy algae, other) ~ Dirichlet, with log(coral/other) ~ lag coral + temperature + disturbance (binary) + lag corallivores + log lagoon recruitment (3-yr lag), and log(fleshy algae/other) ~ lag fleshy algae + temperature + disturbance (binary) + lag herbivores |
| 3 | log(ecosystem respiration) ~ log coral cover + log fleshy algae cover + temperature + Season + (1|Year) |
| 4 | log(Pmax) ~ log coral cover + log fleshy algae cover + temperature + Season + log(N content) + (1|Year) |
| 5 | log corallivore biomass ~ log coral cover |
| 6 | log herbivore biomass ~ log fleshy algae cover |
| 7 | log(nitrogen content) ~ log coral cover + log fleshy algae cover |
| — | residual correlation between equations 3 and 4 (Rd ↔ Pmax) |

Only ecosystem respiration and Pmax are measured seasonally. All other variables are annual values repeated across seasons, so equations 1, 2, 5, 6 and 7 are fit to one row per year using brms `subset()`. This avoids double-counting years. A `(1|Year)` term is not identifiable with one observation per year, so the year random intercept is kept only in the seasonal sub-models (3 and 4). Season enters as a centred fixed effect (Summer = +0.5, Winter = −0.5).

Coral, fleshy algae and all other cover (sand, rubble, crustose coralline algae and remaining categories) are shares of the same total and are not independent. They are therefore modelled jointly as a three-part composition with a Dirichlet distribution, with "other" as the reference category. Coral and fleshy algae each have their own linear predictor, so coefficients are effects on log(coral/other) and log(fleshy algae/other); the effect on log(coral/fleshy algae) is the difference between the two. Each part's previous-year log ratio is included as a predictor (persistence), so the other coefficients are effects on the year-to-year change, and they carry into later years. Grazing is expected to act on fleshy algae and corallivory on coral, so lagged herbivore biomass enters the fleshy-algae predictor, and lagged corallivore biomass and lagged recruitment enter the coral predictor. For interpretability, composition effects are also reported as changes in percentage cover at the average composition. In the downstream equations, coral and fleshy algae enter as standardised log cover; herbivore biomass responds to fleshy algae and corallivore biomass to coral. A model using the single log ratio of coral to fleshy algae (coral dominance) is retained as a supplementary comparison.

Coral recruitment on settlement tiles in the north lagoon at LTER 1 (TILES-1; spat per tile per year, log-transformed) enters the coral predictor with a 3-year lag, allowing for the time recruits need to reach a size detected in benthic surveys. Recruitment is missing for 2018 (one deployment period not sampled) and for 2004–2005 (before the series began), which the 3-year lag requires for 2021 and 2007–2008. These values are imputed jointly with the model using brms `mi()`, with an intercept-only imputation model so that imputed values are not pulled towards any time trend.

Coral and fleshy algae cover are correlated, and both affect N content (equation 7), so their direct and N-mediated paths to Pmax cannot be cleanly separated. Effects on Pmax and Rd are therefore summarised as total effects. The total effect of coral (or fleshy algae) cover on Pmax is its direct path plus the indirect path through N content. The total effect of N content equals its direct path, because N has no other route to Pmax in the model. Annual maximum temperature enters Rd and Pmax directly and also acts through coral and fleshy algae cover. Its total effects add the paths through log coral and log fleshy algae cover, evaluated at the average composition. These are within-year effects; because each benthic part depends on its previous value, part of a temperature effect also carries into later years, which these totals do not include.

Rd and Pmax come from the same incubations and share unmeasured drivers, so their residuals are modelled as correlated. brms cannot estimate residual correlations alongside `subset()`. The SEM is therefore fit as two blocks: (i) an annual block (equations 1, 2, 5, 6, 7) fit with `subset()` and no residual correlations; and (ii) a bivariate metabolism block (equations 3 and 4) fit to the seasonal rows with an estimated Rd–Pmax residual correlation and correlated year intercepts. The blocks share no parameters, and benthic cover and N content enter the metabolism block as observed data. With residual correlations fixed at zero across blocks, the joint posterior factorises, so this is equivalent to one SEM in which only Rd and Pmax have correlated errors.

Total fish biomass was left out of the respiration sub-model. The justification and a with-fish sensitivity model are given below under *Sensitivity: Rd sub-model with fish biomass*.

```{r sem-season-prep}
#| label: sem-season-preparation

# Standardise annual variables over one row per year and seasonal variables
# over the seasonal rows, so years sampled in both seasons are not weighted
# twice in the annual scaling.
scale_on <- function(x, rows) {
  (x - mean(x[rows], na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x[rows], na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Previous-year coral dominance and disturbance, lagged over one row per year
# (YearSeason_Averages has two rows for years sampled in both seasons)
annual_lags <- YearSeason_Averages |>
  distinct(Year, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  arrange(Year) |>
  transmute(Year,
            coraldom_lag1    = lag(coral_dominance),
            Disturbance_lag1 = lag(Disturbance),
            # Previous-year log ratios of coral and fleshy algae to other cover
            lr_coral_lag1    = lag(log(mean_coral / (100 - mean_coral - mean_fleshy))),
            lr_fleshy_lag1   = lag(log(mean_fleshy / (100 - mean_coral - mean_fleshy))))
stopifnot(all(diff(annual_lags$Year) == 1))

# SDs of log coral and log fleshy algae cover over years, used to convert
# Dirichlet effects to the standardised log-cover scale of the downstream
# equations
annual_cover <- YearSeason_Averages |>
  distinct(Year, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(!is.na(mean_coral))
cover_log_sd <- c(coral  = sd(log(annual_cover$mean_coral / 100)),
                  fleshy = sd(log(annual_cover$mean_fleshy / 100)))

# Coral recruitment, north lagoon at LTER 1 (TILES-1): spat per tile summed
# over tile sides and coral families, averaged over tiles, then summed over
# the two deployment periods (Jan-Sep, Sep-Jan). Years missing a deployment
# period are set to NA and imputed in the model with mi().
recruit_lagoon <- read_csv(
  here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER_CoralRecruit_TileSpatCounts_2006-2022_20250403.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(location == "TILES-1", habitat == "Lagoon") |>
  group_by(nominal_year, season, tile_id) |>
  summarise(spat = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(nominal_year, season) |>
  summarise(mean_spat = mean(spat), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(Year = nominal_year) |>
  summarise(recruits = if (n() == 2) sum(mean_spat) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop")
stopifnot(all(recruit_lagoon$recruits > 0, na.rm = TRUE))

# Recruitment 3 years before each coral survey year (spat need several years
# to reach a size detected in benthic surveys)
annual_lags <- annual_lags |>
  left_join(recruit_lagoon |> transmute(Year = Year + 3, recruits_lag3 = recruits),
            by = "Year")

semdata_season <- YearSeason_Averages |>
  left_join(annual_lags, by = "Year") |>
  arrange(Year, Season) |>
  mutate(
    annual_row       = !duplicated(Year),
    seasonal_row     = !is.na(Season),
    year_f           = factor(Year),
    summer           = case_when(Season == "Summer" ~ 0.5,
                                 Season == "Winter" ~ -0.5,
                                 TRUE ~ 0),
    temperature      = Max_temp,
    coraldom         = coral_dominance,
    logherbs_lag1    = log(Herbivores_lag1),
    logcoralliv_lag1 = log(Corallivore_lag1),
    logherbs         = log(Herbivores),
    logcoralliv      = log(Corallivore),
    logN             = log(N_percent),
    logfish          = log(fish_biomass_g_m2),
    logrd            = log(Rd),
    logpmax          = log(Pmax),
    logrec3          = log(recruits_lag3),
    # Benthic composition (proportions) and standardised log cover
    coral_prop       = mean_coral / 100,
    fleshy_prop      = mean_fleshy / 100,
    other_prop       = 1 - coral_prop - fleshy_prop,
    logcoral_z       = log(coral_prop),
    logfleshy_z      = log(fleshy_prop),
    obs_id           = row_number()
  ) |>
  # Lagged coral dominance uses coral dominance's own mean and SD, so the
  # lag coefficient (phi) and the year-to-year change share one scale
  mutate(coraldom_lag1 = (coraldom_lag1 - mean(coraldom[annual_row], na.rm = TRUE)) /
           sd(coraldom[annual_row], na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(Year, temperature, coraldom, logherbs_lag1,
             logcoralliv_lag1, logherbs, logcoralliv, logN, logrec3,
             logcoral_z, logfleshy_z),
           ~ scale_on(.x, annual_row)),
    across(c(logfish, logrd, logpmax), ~ scale_on(.x, seasonal_row))
  ) |>
  # Per-equation subsets: annual sub-models use one row per year; each subset
  # also requires complete response and predictors. Disturbance_lag1 is
  # required for coral so the lagged-disturbance comparison uses the same rows.
  mutate(
    sub_temp     = annual_row & !is.na(temperature),
    sub_coral    = annual_row & if_all(c(coraldom, coraldom_lag1, temperature,
                                         Disturbance_lag1, logherbs_lag1,
                                         logcoralliv_lag1), ~ !is.na(.x)),
    # logfish is required here so the with-fish sensitivity model uses the
    # same rows (needed for the LOO comparison)
    sub_rd       = seasonal_row & if_all(c(logrd, coraldom, temperature, logfish), ~ !is.na(.x)),
    sub_pmax     = seasonal_row & if_all(c(logpmax, coraldom, temperature, logN), ~ !is.na(.x)),
    sub_coralliv = annual_row & !is.na(logcoralliv) & !is.na(coraldom),
    sub_herbs    = annual_row & !is.na(logherbs) & !is.na(coraldom),
    sub_N        = annual_row & !is.na(logN) & !is.na(coraldom)
  ) |>
  # Centre the lagged log ratios over the modelled years; they stay in
  # log-ratio units so their coefficients are persistence parameters
  mutate(lr_coral_lag1  = lr_coral_lag1 - mean(lr_coral_lag1[sub_coral]),
         lr_fleshy_lag1 = lr_fleshy_lag1 - mean(lr_fleshy_lag1[sub_coral])) |>
  select(
    Year, year_f, obs_id, Season, summer, Disturbance, starts_with("sub_"),
    temperature, coraldom, coraldom_lag1, Disturbance_lag1, logherbs_lag1,
    logcoralliv_lag1, logherbs, logcoralliv, logN, coral_prop, fleshy_prop,
    other_prop, lr_coral_lag1, lr_fleshy_lag1, logcoral_z, logfleshy_z,
    logfish, logrd, logpmax, logrec3
  ) |>
  # brms drops any row with an NA, even rows outside a subset. Every NA sits in
  # a row excluded by that variable's subset flag, so a 0 placeholder is
  # never used in the likelihood. Lagged recruitment keeps its NAs within the
  # coral rows, where they are imputed with mi().
  mutate(across(temperature:logpmax, ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
         logrec3 = if_else(sub_coral, logrec3, 0))

# Dirichlet response: a matrix column of the three cover shares ("other" is
# the reference category). Rows outside the coral subset get a placeholder
# composition, which is never used in the likelihood.
semdata_season$comp <- with(semdata_season, cbind(other = other_prop,
                                                  coral = coral_prop,
                                                  fleshy = fleshy_prop))
semdata_season$comp[!semdata_season$sub_coral, ] <- 1 / 3
stopifnot(all(semdata_season$comp > 0),
          all(abs(rowSums(semdata_season$comp) - 1) < 1e-8))

# Observations entering each sub-model
colSums(select(semdata_season, starts_with("sub_")))
```

```{r sem-season-fit}
#| label: sem-season-model
#| cache: true
#| dependson: ["sem-season-preparation", "lagged-covariates"]

# Families: continuous responses are log-transformed and z-scored, so
# gaussian() on these scales is equivalent to lognormal on the raw scale.
# Benthic cover is a three-part composition (coral, fleshy algae, other)
# modelled with dirichlet(); coefficients are on the log(part / other) scale.

# Annual block: one row per year via subset(); no residual correlations
bf_temp_s <- bf(temperature | subset(sub_temp) ~ 1 + Year, family = gaussian())

# Each part has its own predictors: corallivores and recruitment act on
# coral, herbivores on fleshy algae. mi() imputes missing recruitment;
# index(obs_id) links the rows of the two subsetted equations.
bf_comp <- bf(
  comp | subset(sub_coral) ~ 1,
  mucoral  ~ 1 + lr_coral_lag1 + temperature + Disturbance + logcoralliv_lag1 +
    mi(logrec3, idx = obs_id),
  mufleshy ~ 1 + lr_fleshy_lag1 + temperature + Disturbance + logherbs_lag1,
  family = dirichlet()
)
bf_rec_s      <- bf(logrec3 | mi() + index(obs_id) + subset(sub_coral) ~ 1,
                    family = gaussian())
bf_coralliv_s <- bf(logcoralliv | subset(sub_coralliv) ~ 1 + logcoral_z, family = gaussian())
bf_herbs_s    <- bf(logherbs | subset(sub_herbs) ~ 1 + logfleshy_z, family = gaussian())
bf_N_s        <- bf(logN | subset(sub_N) ~ 1 + logcoral_z + logfleshy_z, family = gaussian())

metab_resps  <- c("logrd", "logpmax")
season_resps <- c("temperature", "coral", "fleshy", "logrd", "logpmax",
                  "logcoralliv", "logherbs", "logN")

annual_priors <- c(
  set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "comp", dpar = "mucoral"),
  set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "comp", dpar = "mufleshy"),
  set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "comp", dpar = "mucoral"),
  set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "comp", dpar = "mufleshy"),
  do.call(c, lapply(c("temperature", "logcoralliv", "logherbs", "logN"), \(r) c(
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = r),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = r)
  ))),
  set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "logrec3"),
  set_prior("normal(0, 0.25)", class = "sigma", resp = "temperature", lb = 0)
)

brms_sem_season_annual <- brm(
  bf_temp_s + bf_comp + bf_rec_s + bf_coralliv_s + bf_herbs_s + bf_N_s +
    set_rescor(FALSE),
  data = semdata_season,
  chains = 3,
  iter = 10000,
  warmup = 5000,
  seed = 6081,
  sample_prior = "no",
  prior = annual_priors,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  silent = 2,
  refresh = 0
)
```

```{r sem-season-metab-fit}
#| label: sem-season-metab-model
#| cache: true
#| dependson: ["sem-season-preparation"]

# Metabolism block: Rd and Pmax on the seasonal rows with correlated
# residuals (rescor) and correlated year intercepts (|p|). rescor cannot be
# combined with subset(), so the data are filtered instead.
stopifnot(identical(semdata_season$sub_rd, semdata_season$sub_pmax))
semdata_metab <- semdata_season |> filter(sub_rd)

# Fish biomass is deliberately excluded from Rd (see the sensitivity
# analysis below)
bf_logrd_s   <- bf(logrd ~ 1 + logcoral_z + logfleshy_z + temperature + summer +
                     (1 | p | year_f), family = gaussian())
bf_logpmax_s <- bf(logpmax ~ 1 + logcoral_z + logfleshy_z + temperature + summer +
                     logN + (1 | p | year_f), family = gaussian())

# Year intercept SDs are identified only by the ~10 years sampled in both
# seasons, so they get a tighter half-normal prior; LKJ(2) mildly shrinks
# both correlations towards zero.
metab_priors <- c(
  do.call(c, lapply(metab_resps, \(r) set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = r))),
  do.call(c, lapply(metab_resps, \(r) set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = r))),
  do.call(c, lapply(metab_resps, \(r) set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "sd", resp = r))),
  set_prior("lkj(2)", class = "rescor"),
  set_prior("lkj(2)", class = "cor")
)

brms_sem_season_metab <- brm(
  bf_logrd_s + bf_logpmax_s + set_rescor(TRUE),
  data = semdata_metab,
  chains = 3,
  iter = 10000,
  warmup = 5000,
  seed = 6081,
  sample_prior = "no",
  prior = metab_priors,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  silent = 2,
  refresh = 0
)
```

```{r sem-season-summary}
#| label: sem-season-results

summary(brms_sem_season_annual)
summary(brms_sem_season_metab)
```

```{r sem-season-r2}
#| label: sem-season-r2-calculation

# Bayesian R² (Gelman et al. 2019) and PSIS-LOO are computed from
# posterior_epred() and log_lik() so both blocks, the per-equation subsets
# and the Dirichlet parts are handled the same way.
season_subsets <- c(temperature = "sub_temp", coral = "sub_coral",
                    fleshy = "sub_coral", logrd = "sub_rd", logpmax = "sub_pmax",
                    logcoralliv = "sub_coralliv", logherbs = "sub_herbs",
                    logN = "sub_N")

# Which block a response belongs to, and its rows in semdata_season (the
# metabolism block's data are semdata_season[sub_rd, ] in the same order)
season_fit  <- function(resp) {
  if (resp %in% metab_resps) brms_sem_season_metab else brms_sem_season_annual
}
season_rows <- function(resp) semdata_season[[season_subsets[[resp]]]]

# Coral and fleshy algae are parts of the Dirichlet response "comp"
season_y <- function(resp) {
  col <- if (resp %in% c("coral", "fleshy")) paste0(resp, "_prop") else resp
  semdata_season[[col]][season_rows(resp)]
}
season_draws <- function(resp, type = c("epred", "predict"), fit = season_fit(resp),
                         draw_ids = NULL) {
  fun <- switch(match.arg(type), epred = posterior_epred, predict = posterior_predict)
  if (resp %in% c("coral", "fleshy")) {
    fun(fit, resp = "comp", draw_ids = draw_ids)[, , resp]
  } else {
    fun(fit, resp = resp, draw_ids = draw_ids)
  }
}

# Combined fixed effects from both blocks (coefficient names are unique)
season_fixef <- function(annual = brms_sem_season_annual,
                         metab  = brms_sem_season_metab) {
  rbind(fixef(annual), fixef(metab))
}

bayes_r2_resp <- function(resp, fit = season_fit(resp)) {
  y  <- season_y(resp)
  mu <- season_draws(resp, "epred", fit = fit)
  stopifnot(ncol(mu) == length(y))
  var_mu  <- apply(mu, 1, var)
  var_res <- apply(sweep(mu, 2, y), 1, var)
  median(var_mu / (var_mu + var_res))
}

# resp = NULL gives the joint pointwise log-likelihood of a block
loo_block <- function(fit, resp = NULL) {
  ll <- log_lik(fit, resp = resp)
  chain_id <- rep(seq_len(nchains(fit)), each = ndraws(fit) / nchains(fit))
  loo::loo(ll, r_eff = loo::relative_eff(exp(ll), chain_id = chain_id))
}

season_resp_labels <- c(
  temperature = "Temperature",       coral       = "Coral Cover",
  fleshy      = "Fleshy Algae Cover", logherbs   = "Herbivorous Fish",
  logcoralliv = "Corallivore Fish",  logN        = "N Content",
  logrd       = "Ecosystem Rd",      logpmax     = "Ecosystem Pmax"
)

tibble(
  Response = season_resp_labels[season_resps],
  R2       = sapply(season_resps, bayes_r2_resp)
) |>
  arrange(desc(R2))
```

### Benthic composition: coral and fleshy algae

```{r sem-season-composition-effects}
#| label: sem-season-composition-effects

# Fixed decimals with a true minus sign for inline reporting
fmt <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  sub("^-", "\u2212", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits))
}
summarise_effect <- function(x) {
  tibble(median = median(x), lo95 = quantile(x, 0.025),
         hi95 = quantile(x, 0.975), p_positive = mean(x > 0))
}
# Path coefficient from either block as "est (95% CI lo, hi)"
path_text <- function(term) {
  fe <- season_fixef()
  sprintf("%s (95%% CI %s, %s)", fmt(fe[term, "Estimate"]),
          fmt(fe[term, "Q2.5"]), fmt(fe[term, "Q97.5"]))
}

draws_annual <- as_draws_df(brms_sem_season_annual)

# Cover shares implied by the two Dirichlet linear predictors ("other" = 0)
softmax_shares <- function(mc, mf) {
  den <- 1 + exp(mc) + exp(mf)
  cbind(other = 1 / den, coral = exp(mc) / den, fleshy = exp(mf) / den)
}
# Average composition: intercepts, with lagged log ratios centred,
# continuous predictors standardised and Disturbance = 0
mc0 <- draws_annual$b_mucoral_comp_Intercept
mf0 <- draws_annual$b_mufleshy_comp_Intercept
base_shares <- softmax_shares(mc0, mf0)
# Change in percentage cover for given shifts in the two linear predictors
pp_change <- function(dc, df) 100 * (softmax_shares(mc0 + dc, mf0 + df) - base_shares)

# Dirichlet coefficient draws; mi() terms are stored with a "bsp_" prefix
dirichlet_draw <- function(part, x) {
  nm <- paste0(c("b_", "bsp_"), "mu", part, "_comp_", x)
  draws_annual[[nm[nm %in% names(draws_annual)][1]]]
}
b_c <- function(x) dirichlet_draw("coral", x)
b_f <- function(x) dirichlet_draw("fleshy", x)
dist_pp <- pp_change(b_c("Disturbance"), b_f("Disturbance"))
temp_pp <- pp_change(b_c("temperature"), b_f("temperature"))

comp_effect_draws <- list(
  base_coral       = 100 * base_shares[, "coral"],
  base_fleshy      = 100 * base_shares[, "fleshy"],
  base_other       = 100 * base_shares[, "other"],
  dist_coral_pp    = dist_pp[, "coral"],
  dist_fleshy_pp   = dist_pp[, "fleshy"],
  dist_other_pp    = dist_pp[, "other"],
  dist_ratio       = b_c("Disturbance") - b_f("Disturbance"),
  temp_coral_pp    = temp_pp[, "coral"],
  temp_fleshy_pp   = temp_pp[, "fleshy"],
  temp_other_pp    = temp_pp[, "other"],
  temp_ratio       = b_c("temperature") - b_f("temperature"),
  persist_coral    = b_c("lr_coral_lag1"),
  persist_fleshy   = b_f("lr_fleshy_lag1"),
  recruit_coral    = b_c("milogrec3idxEQobs_id"),
  coralliv_coral   = b_c("logcoralliv_lag1"),
  herbs_fleshy     = b_f("logherbs_lag1")
)
comp_effects <- map_dfr(comp_effect_draws, summarise_effect, .id = "effect")

comp_text <- function(e, p = FALSE, digits = 2) {
  r <- filter(comp_effects, effect == e)
  paste0(sprintf("%s (95%% CI %s, %s)", fmt(r$median, digits), fmt(r$lo95, digits),
                 fmt(r$hi95, digits)),
         if (p) sprintf("; P(> 0) = %s", fmt(r$p_positive)) else "")
}

comp_labels <- c(
  base_coral     = "Coral cover (%)",
  base_fleshy    = "Fleshy algae cover (%)",
  base_other     = "Other cover (%)",
  dist_coral_pp  = "Coral cover (percentage points)",
  dist_fleshy_pp = "Fleshy algae cover (percentage points)",
  dist_other_pp  = "Other cover (percentage points)",
  dist_ratio     = "log(coral / fleshy algae)",
  temp_coral_pp  = "Coral cover (percentage points)",
  temp_fleshy_pp = "Fleshy algae cover (percentage points)",
  temp_other_pp  = "Other cover (percentage points)",
  temp_ratio     = "log(coral / fleshy algae)",
  persist_coral  = "Coral, previous year's log ratio",
  persist_fleshy = "Fleshy algae, previous year's log ratio",
  recruit_coral  = "Lagoon recruitment (t\u22123) \u2192 coral",
  coralliv_coral = "Corallivore biomass (t\u22121) \u2192 coral",
  herbs_fleshy   = "Herbivore biomass (t\u22121) \u2192 fleshy algae"
)

comp_effects |>
  mutate(effect = comp_labels[effect],
         across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kbl(col.names = c("Effect", "Median", "2.5%", "97.5%", "P(> 0)"),
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
  pack_rows("Average composition", 1, 3) |>
  pack_rows("Disturbance year", 4, 7) |>
  pack_rows("Temperature (+1 SD)", 8, 11) |>
  pack_rows("Persistence (log-ratio scale)", 12, 13) |>
  pack_rows("Biotic drivers (log-ratio vs other)", 14, 16)
```

At the average composition (coral `r comp_text("base_coral", digits = 1)`%, fleshy algae `r comp_text("base_fleshy", digits = 1)`%), disturbance years changed fleshy algae cover by `r comp_text("dist_fleshy_pp", p = TRUE, digits = 1)` percentage points and coral cover by `r comp_text("dist_coral_pp", p = TRUE, digits = 1)` percentage points. A 1-SD increase in maximum temperature changed coral cover by `r comp_text("temp_coral_pp", digits = 1)` and fleshy algae cover by `r comp_text("temp_fleshy_pp", digits = 1)` percentage points. Lagged herbivore biomass had a log-ratio effect on fleshy algae of `r comp_text("herbs_fleshy")`, and lagged corallivore biomass an effect on coral of `r comp_text("coralliv_coral")`. In the other direction, herbivore biomass increased with fleshy algae cover (`r path_text("logherbs_logfleshy_z")`) and corallivore biomass with coral cover (`r path_text("logcoralliv_logcoral_z")`). Lagged lagoon recruitment had an effect on coral of `r comp_text("recruit_coral")`.

### Total effects on Pmax and Rd

```{r sem-season-pmax-effects}
#| label: sem-season-pmax-effects

# Indirect paths multiply coefficients from the annual block by coefficients
# from the metabolism block. The two blocks' posteriors are independent, so
# pairing draws by index is valid.
draws_metab <- as_draws_df(brms_sem_season_metab)
stopifnot(nrow(draws_annual) == nrow(draws_metab))

# Temperature effect on standardised log coral and log fleshy algae cover at
# the average composition: d log(p_k) / dT = b_k - sum_j p_j * b_j ("other"
# has b = 0), divided by the SD of log cover
p_c <- base_shares[, "coral"]
p_f <- base_shares[, "fleshy"]
b_temp_c <- b_c("temperature")
b_temp_f <- b_f("temperature")
mean_b   <- p_c * b_temp_c + p_f * b_temp_f
dcoral_dtemp  <- (b_temp_c - mean_b) / cover_log_sd[["coral"]]
dfleshy_dtemp <- (b_temp_f - mean_b) / cover_log_sd[["fleshy"]]

pmax_effect_draws <- tibble(
  # Pmax
  coral_direct     = draws_metab$b_logpmax_logcoral_z,
  coral_indirect   = draws_annual$b_logN_logcoral_z * draws_metab$b_logpmax_logN,
  coral_total      = coral_direct + coral_indirect,
  fleshy_direct    = draws_metab$b_logpmax_logfleshy_z,
  fleshy_indirect  = draws_annual$b_logN_logfleshy_z * draws_metab$b_logpmax_logN,
  fleshy_total     = fleshy_direct + fleshy_indirect,
  # N has no other route to Pmax, so its total effect is its direct path
  N_total          = draws_metab$b_logpmax_logN,
  temp_direct_pmax = draws_metab$b_logpmax_temperature,
  temp_total_pmax  = temp_direct_pmax + dcoral_dtemp * coral_total +
    dfleshy_dtemp * fleshy_total,
  # Rd (cover has no other route to Rd, so totals equal direct paths)
  coral_total_rd   = draws_metab$b_logrd_logcoral_z,
  fleshy_total_rd  = draws_metab$b_logrd_logfleshy_z,
  temp_direct_rd   = draws_metab$b_logrd_temperature,
  temp_total_rd    = temp_direct_rd + dcoral_dtemp * coral_total_rd +
    dfleshy_dtemp * fleshy_total_rd
)

pmax_effects <- map_dfr(pmax_effect_draws, summarise_effect, .id = "effect")

# "median (95% CI lo, hi)", optionally with the posterior probability > 0
effect_text <- function(e, p = FALSE) {
  r <- filter(pmax_effects, effect == e)
  paste0(sprintf("%s (95%% CI %s, %s)", fmt(r$median), fmt(r$lo95), fmt(r$hi95)),
         if (p) sprintf("; P(> 0) = %s", fmt(r$p_positive)) else "")
}

effect_labels <- c(
  coral_direct     = "Coral cover \u2192 Pmax, direct",
  coral_indirect   = "Coral cover \u2192 N \u2192 Pmax, indirect",
  coral_total      = "Coral cover \u2192 Pmax, total",
  fleshy_direct    = "Fleshy algae \u2192 Pmax, direct",
  fleshy_indirect  = "Fleshy algae \u2192 N \u2192 Pmax, indirect",
  fleshy_total     = "Fleshy algae \u2192 Pmax, total",
  N_total          = "N \u2192 Pmax, total (= direct)",
  temp_direct_pmax = "Temperature \u2192 Pmax, direct",
  temp_total_pmax  = "Temperature \u2192 Pmax, total (incl. via cover and N)",
  coral_total_rd   = "Coral cover \u2192 Rd, total (= direct)",
  fleshy_total_rd  = "Fleshy algae \u2192 Rd, total (= direct)",
  temp_direct_rd   = "Temperature \u2192 Rd, direct",
  temp_total_rd    = "Temperature \u2192 Rd, total (incl. via cover)"
)

pmax_effects |>
  mutate(effect = effect_labels[effect],
         across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kbl(col.names = c("Effect", "Median", "2.5%", "97.5%", "P(> 0)"),
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, position = "left") |>
  pack_rows("Pmax", 1, 9) |>
  pack_rows("Rd", 10, 13) |>
  row_spec(which(grepl("total", names(effect_labels))), bold = TRUE)
```

Coral cover had a total effect on Pmax of `r effect_text("coral_total", p = TRUE)` (direct `r effect_text("coral_direct")`; through N content `r effect_text("coral_indirect")`), and fleshy algae cover a total effect of `r effect_text("fleshy_total", p = TRUE)`. The total effect of N content on Pmax was `r effect_text("N_total", p = TRUE)`. Rd was related to coral cover (`r effect_text("coral_total_rd", p = TRUE)`) and fleshy algae cover (`r effect_text("fleshy_total_rd", p = TRUE)`). Maximum temperature had direct effects of `r effect_text("temp_direct_pmax")` on Pmax and `r effect_text("temp_direct_rd")` on Rd; including its effects through benthic cover (and N), its total effects were `r effect_text("temp_total_pmax", p = TRUE)` on Pmax and `r effect_text("temp_total_rd", p = TRUE)` on Rd.

### Coral and fleshy algae cover around disturbances

Coral dominance is a log ratio, so a disturbance that reduces both coral and fleshy algae can leave it nearly unchanged. Plotting the two components separately shows whether the ratio hides coral losses.

```{r sem-season-cover-disturbance}
#| label: fig-sem-season-cover-disturbance
#| fig-cap: "Annual coral and fleshy algae cover at LTER 1 (top) and year-to-year change in cover (bottom). Grey bands mark disturbance years (COTS outbreak 2006\u20132010, Cyclone Oli 2010, bleaching 2016, 2019 and 2024)."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

cover_long <- YearSeason_Averages |>
  distinct(Year, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(Year, Disturbance, Coral = mean_coral, `Fleshy algae` = mean_fleshy) |>
  pivot_longer(c(Coral, `Fleshy algae`), names_to = "Group", values_to = "cover") |>
  filter(!is.na(cover)) |>
  arrange(Group, Year) |>
  group_by(Group) |>
  mutate(change = cover - lag(cover)) |>
  ungroup()

dist_bands <- annotate("rect", xmin = disturbance_years$Year - 0.5,
                       xmax = disturbance_years$Year + 0.5,
                       ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.2)

p_cover <- ggplot(cover_long, aes(Year, cover, color = Group)) +
  dist_bands +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cover (%)", color = NULL)

p_change <- ggplot(filter(cover_long, !is.na(change)), aes(Year, change, color = Group)) +
  dist_bands +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(y = "Change from previous year (% cover)", color = NULL)

(p_cover / p_change) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

```{r sem-season-cover-disturbance-summary}
#| label: sem-season-cover-disturbance-summary

# Mean year-to-year change in each component, in disturbance years and in the
# year after a disturbance
cover_long |>
  left_join(annual_lags |> select(Year, Disturbance_lag1), by = "Year") |>
  filter(!is.na(change)) |>
  mutate(year_type = case_when(
    Disturbance == 1 ~ "Disturbance year",
    Disturbance_lag1 == 1 ~ "Year after disturbance",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) |>
  group_by(Group, year_type) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean_change = mean(change), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(mean_change = round(mean_change, 1))
```

### Posterior predictive checks

Checks for both blocks are built from `posterior_predict()` with **bayesplot**, so the per-equation subsets of the annual block, the Dirichlet parts and the bivariate metabolism block are handled the same way. Rd and Pmax are additionally checked by season (mean and SD), against time, and for their joint correlation, since those are the only seasonally resolved responses.

```{r sem-season-ppc}
#| label: fig-sem-season-ppc
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive density overlays for each sub-model of the seasonal SEM (dark line = observed; light lines = 100 posterior predictive draws). Coral and fleshy algae are cover proportions from the Dirichlet composition."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

set.seed(3517)

# Observed values, predictive draws and row metadata for one sub-model
ppc_parts <- function(resp, ndraws = NULL, fit = season_fit(resp)) {
  rows  <- season_rows(resp)
  draws <- if (is.null(ndraws)) NULL else sample(ndraws(fit), ndraws)
  list(
    y    = season_y(resp),
    yrep = season_draws(resp, "predict", fit = fit, draw_ids = draws),
    meta = semdata_season[rows, c("year_f", "Season")]
  )
}

ppc_season <- lapply(names(season_resp_labels), \(r) ppc_parts(r, ndraws = 100)) |>
  setNames(names(season_resp_labels))

wrap_plots(lapply(names(season_resp_labels), \(r)
  ppc_dens_overlay(ppc_season[[r]]$y, ppc_season[[r]]$yrep) +
    ggtitle(season_resp_labels[[r]]) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
), ncol = 4)
```

```{r sem-season-ppc-rd-pmax}
#| label: fig-sem-season-ppc-rd-pmax
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive checks for the Rd and Pmax sub-models. Top: 50% and 95% predictive intervals by year (Summer offset left, Winter right). Bottom: predicted vs observed mean and SD within each season."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 7

ppc_rd_pmax_plot <- function(r) {
  p  <- ppc_season[[r]]
  yr <- as.numeric(as.character(p$meta$year_f)) +
    if_else(p$meta$Season == "Summer", -0.15, 0.15)
  (ppc_intervals(p$y, p$yrep, x = yr, prob_outer = 0.95) +
     labs(x = "Year", title = season_resp_labels[[r]])) /
    (ppc_stat_grouped(p$y, p$yrep, group = p$meta$Season, stat = "mean", binwidth = 0.1) +
       ggtitle("Mean") +
       ppc_stat_grouped(p$y, p$yrep, group = p$meta$Season, stat = "sd", binwidth = 0.05) +
       ggtitle("SD")) &
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

wrap_elements(ppc_rd_pmax_plot("logrd")) | wrap_elements(ppc_rd_pmax_plot("logpmax"))
```

```{r sem-season-ppc-stats}
#| label: sem-season-ppc-stats

# Bayesian p-values for season-specific mean and SD (values near 0 or 1
# indicate misfit) and 95% predictive-interval coverage, using all draws
ppc_season_stats <- function(r) {
  p  <- ppc_parts(r)
  lo <- apply(p$yrep, 2, quantile, 0.025)
  hi <- apply(p$yrep, 2, quantile, 0.975)
  map_dfr(c("Summer", "Winter"), \(g) {
    i <- p$meta$Season == g
    tibble(
      Response   = season_resp_labels[[r]],
      Season     = g,
      n          = sum(i),
      obs_sd     = sd(p$y[i]),
      pred_sd    = median(apply(p$yrep[, i], 1, sd)),
      p_mean     = mean(rowMeans(p$yrep[, i]) >= mean(p$y[i])),
      p_sd       = mean(apply(p$yrep[, i], 1, sd) >= sd(p$y[i])),
      coverage95 = mean(p$y[i] >= lo[i] & p$y[i] <= hi[i])
    )
  })
}

bind_rows(ppc_season_stats("logrd"), ppc_season_stats("logpmax")) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2)))

# Joint check: does the metabolism block reproduce the observed Rd-Pmax
# correlation? Joint draws are [draw, observation, response].
yrep_metab <- posterior_predict(brms_sem_season_metab)
rep_cor    <- apply(yrep_metab, 1, \(m) cor(m[, 1], m[, 2]))
obs_cor    <- cor(semdata_metab$logrd, semdata_metab$logpmax)
tibble(
  obs_cor      = obs_cor,
  pred_cor     = median(rep_cor),
  pred_cor_lo  = quantile(rep_cor, 0.025),
  pred_cor_hi  = quantile(rep_cor, 0.975),
  p_cor        = mean(rep_cor >= obs_cor)
) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) round(x, 2)))
```

### Seasonal SEM conceptual model

```{r sem-season-dag}
#| label: fig-sem-season-dag
#| cache: false
#| fig-cap: "**Figure 3b.** Directed acyclic graph (DAG) of the seasonal Bayesian multivariate SEM. Coral and fleshy algae cover are parts of one Dirichlet composition (bracket; the third part is other cover), so arrows into them are effects on log(part / other cover); \u03c6 is each part's persistence from the previous year. Dashed arrows are lagged effects (1 year, or 3 years for lagoon recruitment); the dotted double-headed arc is the Rd\u2013Pmax residual correlation; the box gives total within-year effects (direct + indirect). Disturbance (0/1) and Season (Summer = +0.5, Winter = \u22120.5) coefficients are differences between groups, not per-SD effects."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.6

pos_col  <- "#1565C0"
neg_col  <- "#B71C1C"
nsig_col <- "#AAAAAA"

fe_season <- season_fixef()

sdag_nodes <- tribble(
  ~id,           ~label,                     ~x,   ~y,   ~fill,     ~border,
  "Year",        "Year",                     0.4,  4.9,  "white",   "#888888",
  "Temp",        "Max\nTemperature",         1.9,  4.9,  "white",   "#888888",
  "Dist",        "Disturbance",              1.9,  2.7,  "white",   "#888888",
  "Recruit",     "Lagoon\nRecruitment",      1.9,  0.9,  "white",   "#888888",
  # Benthic composition (Dirichlet parts)
  "Coral",       "Coral Cover",              4.1,  3.6,  "#E8F5E9", "#2E7D32",
  "Algae",       "Fleshy Algae Cover",       4.1,  1.8,  "#E8F5E9", "#2E7D32",
  # Ecosystem function
  "Season",      "Season\n(Summer)",         7.8,  6.1,  "white",   "#888888",
  "Rd",          "Ecosystem\nRespiration",   6.1,  5.0,  "#EDE7F6", "#4527A0",
  "Pmax",        "Ecosystem\nPmax",          9.5,  5.0,  "#EDE7F6", "#4527A0",
  "N",           "N\nContent",               7.7,  3.4,  "#FFF8E1", "#E65100",
  # Community composition
  "Herbs",       "Herbivore\nFish",          6.5,  0.8,  "#E3F2FD", "#0D47A1",
  "Corallivore", "Corallivore\nFish",        9.3,  2.0,  "#E3F2FD", "#0D47A1"
) |>
  # Persistence (previous-year log ratio) shown inside the benthic nodes
  mutate(label = case_when(
    id == "Coral" ~ sprintf("%s\n\u03c6 = %.2f (t\u22121)", label,
                            fe_season["mucoral_comp_lr_coral_lag1", "Estimate"]),
    id == "Algae" ~ sprintf("%s\n\u03c6 = %.2f (t\u22121)", label,
                            fe_season["mufleshy_comp_lr_fleshy_lag1", "Estimate"]),
    TRUE ~ label
  ))

# Estimates are pulled from the fitted models; only layout is set by hand.
# pos = position of the label along the edge; loff = label offset.
sdag_map <- tribble(
  ~coef,                                 ~from,         ~to,           ~lag, ~curv, ~pos, ~loff_x, ~loff_y,
  "temperature_Year",                    "Year",        "Temp",        "",    0,    0.50,  0.00,   0.20,
  "mucoral_comp_temperature",            "Temp",        "Coral",       "",    0,    0.55,  0.22,   0.08,
  "mufleshy_comp_temperature",           "Temp",        "Algae",       "",    0,    0.30, -0.30,   0.00,
  "mucoral_comp_Disturbance",            "Dist",        "Coral",       "",    0,    0.28,  0.00,   0.16,
  "mufleshy_comp_Disturbance",           "Dist",        "Algae",       "",    0,    0.28,  0.00,  -0.16,
  "mucoral_comp_milogrec3idxEQobs_id",   "Recruit",     "Coral",       "t\u22123", 0, 0.22, -0.40, 0.00,
  "mucoral_comp_logcoralliv_lag1",       "Corallivore", "Coral",       "t\u22121", -0.25, 0.50, 0.00, -0.55,
  "mufleshy_comp_logherbs_lag1",         "Herbs",       "Algae",       "t\u22121", -0.40, 0.50, 0.00, -0.55,
  "logcoralliv_logcoral_z",              "Coral",       "Corallivore", "",    0,    0.75,  0.10,   0.18,
  "logherbs_logfleshy_z",                "Algae",       "Herbs",       "",    0,    0.55,  0.20,   0.12,
  "logN_logcoral_z",                     "Coral",       "N",           "",    0,    0.70,  0.00,   0.15,
  "logN_logfleshy_z",                    "Algae",       "N",           "",    0,    0.52,  0.05,  -0.20,
  "logrd_logcoral_z",                    "Coral",       "Rd",          "",    0,    0.45, -0.22,   0.08,
  "logrd_logfleshy_z",                   "Algae",       "Rd",          "",    0,    0.62,  0.25,   0.00,
  "logrd_temperature",                   "Temp",        "Rd",          "",    0,    0.50,  0.00,   0.15,
  "logrd_summer",                        "Season",      "Rd",          "",    0,    0.50, -0.20,   0.15,
  "logpmax_logcoral_z",                  "Coral",       "Pmax",        "",    0,    0.62,  0.00,   0.16,
  "logpmax_logfleshy_z",                 "Algae",       "Pmax",        "",    0,    0.88,  0.30,  -0.05,
  "logpmax_temperature",                 "Temp",        "Pmax",        "",   -0.20, 0.50,  0.00,   0.85,
  "logpmax_summer",                      "Season",      "Pmax",        "",    0,    0.50,  0.20,   0.15,
  "logpmax_logN",                        "N",           "Pmax",        "",    0,    0.50,  0.22,  -0.08
)
stopifnot(all(sdag_map$coef %in% rownames(fe_season)))

sdag_edges <- sdag_map |>
  mutate(
    est       = fe_season[coef, "Estimate"],
    lo        = fe_season[coef, "Q2.5"],
    hi        = fe_season[coef, "Q97.5"],
    sig       = sign(lo) == sign(hi),
    direction = if_else(est >= 0, "pos", "neg"),
    abs_est   = abs(est),
    lagged    = lag != ""
  ) |>
  left_join(sdag_nodes |> select(from = id, x0 = x, y0 = y), by = "from") |>
  left_join(sdag_nodes |> select(to = id, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = "to") |>
  mutate(lx  = x0 + pos * (x1 - x0) + loff_x,
         ly  = y0 + pos * (y1 - y0) + loff_y,
         lbl = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", est), if_else(lagged, paste0(" (", lag, ")"), "")))

# Rd-Pmax residual correlation, drawn as a double-headed arc
rescor_season <- posterior_summary(brms_sem_season_metab,
                                   variable = "rescor__logrd__logpmax")
rescor_edge <- tibble(
  x0 = sdag_nodes$x[sdag_nodes$id == "Rd"], y0 = sdag_nodes$y[sdag_nodes$id == "Rd"],
  x1 = sdag_nodes$x[sdag_nodes$id == "Pmax"], y1 = sdag_nodes$y[sdag_nodes$id == "Pmax"],
  sig = sign(rescor_season[, "Q2.5"]) == sign(rescor_season[, "Q97.5"]),
  lbl = sprintf("r = %.2f", rescor_season[, "Estimate"])
)

# Compositional bracket to the left of the two benthic nodes
bracket_x <- 3.05
bracket <- tibble(
  x    = c(bracket_x, bracket_x, bracket_x),
  xend = c(bracket_x, bracket_x + 0.12, bracket_x + 0.12),
  y    = c(1.8, 1.8, 3.6),
  yend = c(3.6, 1.8, 3.6)
)

# Total effects (direct + indirect, from the effects chunk), shown in a box
total_line <- function(lab, e) {
  r <- filter(pmax_effects, effect == e)
  sprintf("%s: %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", lab, r$median, r$lo95, r$hi95)
}
total_box <- tibble(
  x = 1.5, y = 6.15,
  lbl = paste(
    "Total effects (direct + indirect)",
    total_line("Coral \u2192 Pmax", "coral_total"),
    total_line("Fleshy algae \u2192 Pmax", "fleshy_total"),
    total_line("N \u2192 Pmax", "N_total"),
    total_line("Temp \u2192 Pmax", "temp_total_pmax"),
    total_line("Temp \u2192 Rd", "temp_total_rd"),
    sep = "\n")
)

dag_arr <- arrow(length = unit(3.0, "mm"), type = "closed")

# One layer per edge so curvature and linetype can vary by edge
sdag_edge_layers <- function(d) {
  lapply(split(d, seq_len(nrow(d))), \(e) {
    mapping <- aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, linewidth = abs_est)
    args <- list(data = e, alpha = if (e$sig) 0.82 else 0.45, arrow = dag_arr,
                 lineend = "butt", linetype = if (e$lagged) "dashed" else "solid")
    if (e$sig) mapping$colour <- quote(direction) else args$colour <- nsig_col
    if (e$curv != 0) {
      do.call(geom_curve, c(list(mapping = mapping, curvature = e$curv), args))
    } else {
      do.call(geom_segment, c(list(mapping = mapping), args))
    }
  })
}

fig3_season <- ggplot() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 5.2, xmax = 10.4, ymin = 2.95, ymax = 6.6,
           fill = "#EDE7F6", alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 5.2, xmax = 10.4, ymin = 0.2, ymax = 2.6,
           fill = "#E3F2FD", alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
```

### Seasonal SEM path coefficients

```{r sem-season-paths}
#| label: fig-sem-season-paths
#| cache: false
#| fig-cap: "**Figure 4b.** Seasonal SEM path coefficient effect sizes (posterior mean and 95% CI; faded = CI crosses zero). Coral and fleshy algae panels are Dirichlet effects on log(part / other cover). Diamonds = total within-year effects: coral and fleshy algae cover on Pmax (direct + via N content) and temperature on Rd and Pmax (direct + via benthic cover). The total effects of N on Pmax and of cover on Rd equal their direct paths."
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 6.5

path_resp_labels <- c(
  temperature = "Temperature",
  coralshare  = "Coral Cover (log ratio)",
  fleshyshare = "Fleshy Algae (log ratio)",
  logherbs    = "Herbivorous Fish",
  logcoralliv = "Corallivore Fish",
  logN        = "N Content",
  logrd       = "Ecosystem Rd",
  logpmax     = "Ecosystem Pmax"
)
path_pred_labels <- c(
  Year                 = "Year",
  lr_coral_lag1        = "Coral (t\u22121)",
  lr_fleshy_lag1       = "Fleshy Algae (t\u22121)",
  temperature          = "Max Temperature",
  temperature_total    = "Max Temperature (total, incl. via cover)",
  Disturbance          = "Disturbance (0/1)",
  logherbs_lag1        = "Herbivorous Fish (t\u22121)",
  logcoralliv_lag1     = "Corallivore Fish (t\u22121)",
  milogrec3idxEQobs_id = "Lagoon Recruitment (t\u22123)",
  logcoral_z           = "Coral Cover",
  coral_total          = "Coral Cover (total, incl. via N)",
  logfleshy_z          = "Fleshy Algae Cover",
  fleshy_total         = "Fleshy Algae Cover (total, incl. via N)",
  summer               = "Season (Summer \u2212 Winter)",
  logN                 = "N Content"
)

# Dirichlet coefficient names (mucoral_comp_x) are recoded so that the
# response and predictor split on the first "_"
gp_edges_season <- as_tibble(season_fixef(), rownames = "coef") |>
  mutate(coef = sub("^mucoral_comp_", "coralshare_", coef),
         coef = sub("^mufleshy_comp_", "fleshyshare_", coef)) |>
  separate(coef, into = c("resp", "pred"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |>
  filter(pred != "Intercept", resp %in% names(path_resp_labels)) |>
  transmute(resp, pred, est = Estimate, lo = `Q2.5`, hi = `Q97.5`,
            effect_type = "Direct path") |>
  # Total effects from the effects chunk
  bind_rows(
    pmax_effects |>
      filter(effect %in% c("coral_total", "fleshy_total", "temp_total_pmax", "temp_total_rd")) |>
      transmute(
        resp = if_else(effect == "temp_total_rd", "logrd", "logpmax"),
        pred = recode(effect, coral_total = "coral_total", fleshy_total = "fleshy_total",
                      temp_total_pmax = "temperature_total", temp_total_rd = "temperature_total"),
        est = median, lo = lo95, hi = hi95, effect_type = "Total effect"
      )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sig  = if_else(sign(lo) == sign(hi), 1, 0.5),
    resp = factor(path_resp_labels[resp], path_resp_labels),
    pred = factor(path_pred_labels[pred], rev(path_pred_labels))
  )
stopifnot(!anyNA(gp_edges_season$resp), !anyNA(gp_edges_season$pred))

gp_edges_season |>
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = pred)) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = sig, shape = effect_type), size = 3, color = "firebrick") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi, alpha = sig), width = 0,
                orientation = "y", color = "firebrick") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.4, 1), guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Direct path" = 16, "Total effect" = 18), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1, 0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized Effect Size",
    y = "Predictor Variables"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~resp, nrow = 1, labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 14)) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
    strip.clip = "off",
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
